text:
alex: starting a 10% staged rollout for inference-service v2.3.4 now. watch for 5xx and latency tails. tagging infra and ops.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-service v2.3.4 -> 10% traffic (canary). Links: https://deploys/redwood/inf/v2.3.4 · [logs] · [metrics]
shawn: seeing a small spike in 5xx on eu-west-1 edge at ~2m into rollout, +0.8% baseline -> 1.6%. still within alert thresholds but worth eyeballing.
maria: confirmed, request traces show timeouts from embedding backend on a subset of requests. CPU on the pod pool also bumped ~15%.
sophia: can we pause and pin traffic back to v2.3.3 if it gets worse? what rollback candidate is ready?
alex: hold at 10% for now. deploy-bot, pause further increases. opsbot, can you surface the pinned candidate and artifact checksum?
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 10% by manual hold (alex). No automatic rollback triggered.
opsbot: Rollback candidate: inference-service v2.3.3 (sha256: a1b2c3...). Hotfix branch hotfix/kv-cache-fix built and smoke-tested on staging.
maria: reproducing locally with the canary config — looks like a KV cache eviction pattern causing retries. If we revert, we should pin routing to v2.3.3 and hold traffic.
sophia: suggested command to pin back: `redwoodctl routing pin --service inference-service --version v2.3.3 --reason "canary 10% spike"`  — that will send 100% to pinned version until unpinned.
alex: agreed. plan: pin to v2.3.3, rollback canary, collect heap/kvcache traces for 30m, and then decide whether to reattempt with a patched build. who will run the pin?
shawn: i'll run the pin and do the rollback. running now.
shawn: `redwoodctl routing pin --service inference-service --version v2.3.3 --reason "canary 10% spike"` -> accepted.
deploy-bot: Routing update: inference-service pinned to v2.3.3 by shawn. Traffic shift: 100% -> v2.3.3.
shawn: triggering rollback for canary canary instances: `redwoodctl rollback --service inference-service --from-version v2.3.4 --to-version v2.3.3 --scope canary`
deploy-bot: Rollback action queued. Rolling back canary workers. ETA ~45s.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary instances replaced. Observability: 5xx rate back to baseline within 2 minutes.
maria: verifying traces — 5xx dropped to baseline, CPU normalized. collecting additional traces for further RCA.
sophia: marking release notes: add entry "v2.3.4 reverted from canary due to KV cache eviction causing transient 5xx; investigating; candidate hotfix branch: hotfix/kv-cache-fix"
alex: thanks. we'll keep this pinned and schedule a postmortem/triage with infra and runtime tomorrow. re-open rollout only after fixes and a new canary run. meeting in 30m if needed.
shawn: :thumbsup:
maria: syncing logs to ticket INF-3421 and attaching traces.
opsbot: Incident ticket INF-3421 created and linked to rollout thread.
alex: closing the thread for now — all agreed on pin + rollback and investigation. reopen if telemetry shifts.
